0.headline: Avtar Steel files IPO papers to raise fresh capital of Rs 585 crore
0.heading: Avtar Steel files IPO papers to raise fresh capital of Rs 585 crore
0.intro: Avtar Steel IPO | The public issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 585 crore, while promoter Sumit Jindal has proposed to sell up to 50 lakh shares through an offer for sale.
0.body:
Delhi-based stainless-steel long and wire products maker Avtar Steel has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to raise funds through an initial public offering (IPO).

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 585 crore, while promoter Sumit Jindal has proposed to sell up to 50 lakh shares through an offer for sale (OFS).

The company may also raise up to Rs 117 crore through a pre-IPO placement. Any amount raised through the pre-IPO round will be deducted from the fresh issue component.

Where Avtar Steel will use IPO proceeds
Avtar Steel plans to use Rs 200 crore from the fresh issue to part-finance capital expenditure for a new specialty steel melting facility. The facility will manufacture special steel, stainless-steel blocks and blooms, while part of the funds will also be used to expand stainless-steel wire production at its existing facility.

Another Rs 200 crore will be used to repay debt. The company's total outstanding borrowings stood at Rs 339.3 crore as of July 2026. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

The company operates three manufacturing facilities in Sonipat, Haryana, with a combined capacity of 72,000 MTPA in steel melting, 1.2 lakh MTPA in wire rods and bars, and 24,000 MTPA in hot-rolling and cold-finishing.

Avtar Steel financials
Avtar Steel supplied stainless-steel long and wire products to 422 customers in FY26, including 265 repeat customers who contributed nearly 86 percent of its revenue.

Its customers include Bansal Wire Industries, Goodluck India, Stellaris Specialities India, Vividh Wires, Ivy Creations UK, Goodluck Defense and Aerospace and Victura Technologies.

The company reported a 59.4 percent increase in profit to Rs 59.04 crore in FY26 from Rs 37 crore a year earlier. Revenue rose 13.5 percent to Rs 1,263.3 crore from Rs 1,112.8 crore.

Avtar Steel competes with listed companies such as Mangalam Worldwide, Welspun Specialty Solutions and Mukand.

According to a CARE report, India's stainless-steel market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 8.2 percent between FY26 and FY30, reaching around Rs 1.7 lakh crore by FY30. Infrastructure spending and growing applications in green hydrogen, smart urban infrastructure, renewable energy and tunnel construction are expected to support demand.

The company's shares are proposed to be listed on the BSE and NSE. Systematix Corporate Services and Elara Capital (India) are the merchant bankers for the IPO.

1.headline: Synergy Advanced Metals receive SEBI approval to go ahead with IPO plans
1.heading: Synergy Advanced Metals receive SEBI approval to go ahead with IPO plans
1.intro: Synergy Advanced Metals IPO | It will be a mainboard IPO and has proposed to list its equity shares on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange.
1.body:
New Delhi-headquartered stainless steel solutions provider Synergy Advanced Metals has received approval from capital markets regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to proceed with its fundraising plans through an initial public offering (IPO).

The company had filed its draft offer document through the confidential route in March-April 2026. As a result, details of the proposed IPO size have not been made public.

SEBI issued its observations on Synergy Advanced Metals’ draft papers on August 13, according to the processing status of draft offer documents published on August 14.

Under the confidential filing route, the issuance of SEBI’s observations gives the company an 18-month window to launch its IPO. After incorporating observations from SEBI and the stock exchanges, the company will have to file an updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) for public comments.

It will then file its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP), or an updated version of the Updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus (UDRHP), along with details of the IPO opening dates after incorporating public comments.

For a conventional DRHP filing, where the document is made available to the public, companies have a 12-month window after receiving SEBI’s observation letter.

Synergy Advanced Metals plans to launch a mainboard IPO and list its equity shares on the BSE and National Stock Exchange.

What does Synergy Advanced Metals do?
The company manufactures stainless steel products including wire rods, wire, billets, bright bars, hot-rolled flats and fasteners from scrap at its manufacturing facility in Alwar, Rajasthan.

Its products cater to industries including aerospace, medical devices, renewable energy and precision engineering.

Ambit has been appointed as the book-running lead manager for the Synergy Advanced Metals IPO. Details of any other merchant bankers are not known as the company used the confidential filing route.

Other IPO papers with SEBI
Meanwhile, the processing status of draft offer documents showed that the draft papers of 37 companies are currently under process with SEBI.

The companies include Paras Healthcare, Ratnadeep Retail, Renfra Energy India, Carlsberg India, Swara Baby Products, Emerald Jewels, IFL Finance, Veritas Finance, Encube Ethicals, Assetz and Muthoot Fincorp.

SEBI has also sought clarifications from merchant bankers on the draft papers of 21 companies, including Sterlite Electric, Sadbhav Futuretech, Arohan Financial Services, Razorpay Software, National Stock Exchange, Innoterra, TMC Transformer India, Yogiji Digi, MakeMyTrip India, Indian Gas Exchange and Beauty Garage.

Meanwhile, in-principle approvals from stock exchanges are awaited on the draft papers of three companies — Jainam Broking, Punjab Carbonics and Matangi Rubber.

2.headline: Shiprocket IPO GMP: Grey market premium signals 38% listing gain as issue enters final day
2.heading: Shiprocket IPO GMP: Grey market premium signals 38% listing gain as issue enters final day
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Gurugram-based e-commerce enablement platform Shiprocket is witnessing strong demand on the final day of bidding, while its shares continue to command a premium of around 38 percent in the unofficial grey market.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Gurugram-based e-commerce enablement platform Shiprocket is witnessing strong demand on the final day of bidding, while its shares continue to command a premium of around 38 percent in the unofficial grey market.

According to InvestorGain and IPO Watch, Shiprocket's grey market premium (GMP) is around Rs 37, implying a potential listing premium of about 38 percent over the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 97.

However, GMP is an unofficial indicator and is based on activity and sentiment in the grey market. It is not regulated or an official price discovery mechanism and does not guarantee listing gains or the stock's performance after listing.

Read Also: 'Husband quits job, becomes full-time trader with father's money': Woman asks if Rs 1-2 lakh monthly income is realistic

The Rs 1,617.5-crore Shiprocket IPO was subscribed around 84 times as of 3:20 pm on August 14, based on NSE data. The issue received bids for 7,92,03,82,316 equity shares against 9,44,36,030 shares available for subscription.

The IPO opened on August 12 and will close on August 14. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 92-97 per share and is seeking to raise Rs 1,617.5 crore at the upper end of the price band.

The issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 885.5 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of Rs 732 crore by existing shareholders.

Ahead of the public issue, Shiprocket raised Rs 727.41 crore from 50 anchor investors on August 11. The company allotted 7.5 crore equity shares to anchor investors at Rs 97 apiece.

The anchor book included investors such as Nomura, Ashoka WhiteOak, Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale.

Domestic mutual funds accounted for a significant portion of the anchor allocation, with 5 crore shares allotted to 13 domestic mutual funds through 31 schemes. These included schemes managed by SBI Mutual Fund, HDFC AMC, Nippon Life India, Kotak Mahindra AMC, UTI AMC, Mirae Asset, Edelweiss, PGIM India and Bandhan Mutual Fund.

Shiprocket plans to use Rs 365.6 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue towards marketing initiatives and investments in technology infrastructure and capabilities.

Check IPO News Here

Another Rs 210 crore has been earmarked for repayment or prepayment of borrowings. The company had total borrowings of around Rs 242 crore as of March 31, 2026.

Shiprocket continues to remain loss-making despite reporting growth in revenue. The company reported a net loss of Rs 79.25 crore in FY26, compared with a net loss of Rs 74.45 crore in FY25. Its total income increased to Rs 2,077.42 crore in FY26 from Rs 1,674.82 crore in FY25.

EBITDA loss stood at Rs 16.56 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 17.16 crore in FY25.

The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on August 17, while refunds and credit of shares to eligible investors are scheduled for August 18. Shiprocket shares are expected to list on the NSE and BSE on August 19, subject to the final timetable.

About Shiprocket

Shiprocket operates an e-commerce enablement platform covering logistics, fulfilment, payments, checkout, customer engagement and cross-border commerce. The company caters to MSMEs and large retailers.
